title: IA empresarial
blurb: Levar a IA para dentro de uma empresa: casos de uso, arquitetura, governação e valor.

lessons.title: Porque é que as empresas adotam IA
lessons.summary: As alavancas de valor por trás do hype.

cards.title: Quatro alavancas de valor
cards.text: A IA cria valor de negócio de quatro formas principais: fazer o trabalho mais depressa e mais barato, tomar melhores decisões, melhorar a experiência do cliente e permitir novos produtos ou receitas.

deep.x: Most AI business cases map onto four levers. Naming the lever clarifies what to measure and who owns the result.
Typical metrics per lever

items.b: cost per transaction, cycle time, FTE capacity

deep.x: Mixing levers
Strong use cases often hit several at once: automated contract extraction cuts processing time (efficiency), reduces missed obligations (risk) and speeds up invoicing (cash flow).
Prioritising
Efficiency gains are easiest to measure; decision and growth gains are often larger but harder to prove. A balanced portfolio includes both.
Tie every AI initiative to one primary lever and one primary metric before starting.

cards.title: Produtividade

steps: A IA faz a primeira passagem
Tempo livre para trabalho de critério

cards.text: Automatizar ou acelerar trabalho intelectual de rotina, como ler documentos, redigir, reconciliar ou responder a perguntas habituais, liberta as pessoas para trabalho de maior valor.

deep.x: Knowledge-work productivity gains come from removing low-value effort: searching, re-typing, reformatting, summarising, first drafts and routine answers.
Where time goes
Studies of knowledge workers repeatedly find large shares of time spent searching for information, in email and on coordination. These are prime AI targets.

v.unit: share of a knowledge worker's week, % (illustrative)

deep.x: Measured gains

items.b: ~14% more issues resolved per hour (2023 study)
~55% faster on a defined task (2022 study)

deep.x: From minutes to processes
Individual time savings are scattered; redesigning a whole process (e.g. accounts payable end to end) captures larger, measurable gains.
Individual productivity gains often don't show up in company results unless workflows, roles and targets are adjusted to use the freed time.

cards.title: Melhores decisões

items: Risco de crédito e de contraparte

cards.text: Prever com mais precisão a procura, os preços, o risco ou as necessidades de manutenção reduz o desperdício e melhora as margens. No trading, pequenas melhorias nas previsões podem valer muito.

deep.x: Predictive models and AI-assisted analysis improve decisions that are made frequently and where small accuracy gains compound: pricing, inventory, credit, maintenance, logistics, hedging.
Why small improvements matter
In high-volume, thin-margin businesses like commodity trading, a slightly better forecast or freight decision applied to millions of tonnes can be worth millions.

x: 5 million tonnes a year
× €0.50/t better execution
= €2.5 million a year

deep.x: Decision intelligence
Combine predictions with optimisation and human judgement: the model forecasts, an optimiser proposes actions, and experts decide with full context.
Pitfalls
Present forecasts with ranges and drivers; decision-makers trust what they understand.

cards.title: Experiência do cliente
cards.text: Respostas mais rápidas e 24/7, recomendações personalizadas e um processamento mais rápido de encomendas e reclamações aumentam a satisfação e a fidelização.

deep.x: AI improves customer experience through speed, availability, personalisation and consistency.
Customer service pattern

steps: Complex cases routed to humans with summary

deep.x: B2B context
In B2B, experience means fast quotes, accurate order status, quick document turnaround (contracts, certificates, invoices) and proactive alerts about delays.
Watch-outs
Customers often accept bots for simple questions but strongly prefer a quick route to a human for complex or emotional issues.

cards.title: Risco e conformidade
cards.text: A IA consegue analisar transações à procura de fraude, verificar contratos face às políticas, monitorizar listas de sanções e assinalar anomalias muito mais depressa do que a revisão manual.

deep.x: Compliance functions face growing volumes of transactions, regulations and documents. AI can screen at scale and focus human experts on the cases that matter.
Use cases
False positives
Traditional rule-based screening often generates huge numbers of false alerts. ML and LLMs can reduce noise, letting analysts focus on real risks, if carefully validated.
Governance needed
Using AI in compliance itself requires documentation, explainability, auditability and regular validation, since regulators will ask how decisions were made.
In compliance, AI should make humans more effective, not remove accountability.

cards.title: Não é só cortar custos
cards.text: Os programas de IA mais fortes tratam a IA como uma capacidade para crescer e trabalhar melhor, não apenas para reduzir pessoal. O enquadramento afeta a adoção: as pessoas abraçam ferramentas que as ajudam.

deep.x: Framing AI purely as headcount reduction creates fear and resistance, slowing adoption. Framing it as capability and growth tends to drive faster, broader use.
Where value goes
Honest communication
People see through vague promises. Be clear about goals, how roles may change, and the support available: training, redeployment and involvement in redesign.
Evidence
Surveys repeatedly show employees adopt tools faster when they see personal benefit (less tedious work) and trust leadership's intentions.
Many organisations use AI savings first to clear backlogs and absorb growth, which avoids layoffs while showing real value.

cards.title: Onde se concentra o valor
cards.text: O valor tende a concentrar-se em processos centrais com grande volume, decisões repetitivas e muitos documentos ou dados: operações financeiras, apoio ao cliente, cadeia de abastecimento, vendas e desenvolvimento de software.

deep.x: Value concentrates where volume, cost and repetition meet. Analyses of generative AI's economic potential highlight a few functions.

items.l: of GenAI value in just 4 functions
customer ops, marketing & sales, software, R&D

deep.x: In commodity trading and agribusiness
Finding concentration
Shared services
Finance, procurement and HR shared service centres combine volume, standardisation and documentation, making them strong early candidates.
Follow the volume: a modest gain on a high-volume process beats a big gain on a rare one.

cards.title: Hype vs. realidade
cards.text: Muitos pilotos nunca chegam a produção. O problema raramente é o modelo, mas sim os dados, a integração, a mudança de processos e a confiança. Planeia isso desde o primeiro dia.

deep.x: Surveys in 2024–25 consistently found most organisations experimenting with AI, but far fewer scaling it with measurable financial impact. One widely discussed 2025 MIT study claimed around 95% of generative AI pilots produced no measurable P&L impact; methodology was debated, but the pattern was familiar.
Why pilots stall

items: Risk and compliance late in the process

deep.x: What scaling organisations do
The pilot trap
Pilots optimised for demos (clean data, enthusiastic users) don't reveal production problems. Design pilots as the first phase of production.
Treat a pilot's success criteria as production criteria, just at smaller scale.

cards.title: Pressão competitiva
cards.text: À medida que os concorrentes adotam IA, a fasquia de rapidez e custo muda. Esperar pode significar ficar para trás; avançar à pressa sem bases pode desperdiçar dinheiro. Ganha uma abordagem constante e priorizada.

deep.x: As AI lowers costs and speeds up processes, industry baselines shift. Customers come to expect faster responses; competitors operate with leaner cost structures.
Strategic positioning
Sector dynamics

In commodity trading, information advantages are core. AI that processes market data, news, weather and logistics signals faster can sharpen decisions, but competitors access similar tools, so proprietary data and integration become differentiators.

steps: Differentiation shifts to proprietary data, processes and talent

deep.x: Measured approach
A prioritised roadmap, built on solid foundations and refreshed every six months, balances urgency with discipline.
When everyone has access to the same frontier models, competitive advantage comes from how well they're applied to unique data and processes.

cards.title: Começa pelo problema

items.r: "temos de reduzir para metade o tempo das faturas"

cards.text: Os melhores projetos de IA partem de um problema de negócio com um responsável e um resultado mensurável, e não de uma tecnologia à procura de utilidade.

deep.x: Technology-first projects ("we need a chatbot") often struggle to find value. Problem-first projects start from a pain point with a measurable outcome and a committed owner.

items.r: "Reduce contract processing time from 5 days to 1 with ≥98% field accuracy"

deep.x: Problem statement template

items: What does success look like, in numbers?

deep.x: Then choose the solution
The solution may be AI, process change, better software, or a combination. Sometimes a simple rule or a form redesign beats any model.
Owner commitment
A business owner who will change processes and champion adoption matters more than technical sophistication.
If nobody owns the problem, nobody will own the solution.

quiz.q: Qual destas NÃO é uma das quatro principais alavancas de valor da IA?
quiz.explain: As alavancas são produtividade, decisões, experiência do cliente e novas receitas.

quiz.q: Porque é que muitos pilotos de IA não chegam a produção?
options: Não se trata dos dados, da integração, da mudança de processos nem da confiança
quiz.explain: O modelo raramente é o principal obstáculo.

quiz.q: Um bom projeto de IA começa por…
options: Um problema de negócio com um responsável e um resultado mensurável
quiz.explain: Primeiro o problema, depois a tecnologia.

lessons.title: Encontrar casos de uso
lessons.summary: Identificar e priorizar onde a IA ajuda.

cards.title: Procura padrões
cards.text: Bons candidatos envolvem tarefas repetitivas, muito texto ou documentos, regras claras com muitas exceções, ou decisões baseadas em dados históricos.

deep.x: Certain patterns signal strong AI potential. Spotting them speeds up discovery.
Signals in a process

items: Long queues of documents to read
Decisions based on gut feel with data available

deep.x: Anti-patterns
Example map
The best AI opportunities often hide in the "swivel chair" work between systems.

cards.title: Pergunta a quem faz o trabalho
cards.text: As melhores ideias vêm de quem está na linha da frente e sabe onde se perde tempo. Workshops e análises do processo passo a passo fazem-nas surgir depressa.

deep.x: Front-line staff know where time disappears, which exceptions are common and which workarounds exist. Their insight is often more valuable than top-down brainstorming.
Workshop format
Good questions

items.b: "What do you do the same way every day?"
"What do you have to look up often?"

deep.x: Involvement builds adoption
People who help design a solution are far more likely to use it and champion it.
Process mining tools can analyse system logs to reveal actual process flows and bottlenecks, complementing interviews.

cards.title: Valor vs. viabilidade
cards.text: Pontua cada ideia em valor de negócio e viabilidade (dados disponíveis, dificuldade técnica, risco). Começa pelas ideias de alto valor e alta viabilidade: as vitórias rápidas.

deep.x: A 2×2 matrix of value against feasibility helps prioritise a long list of ideas transparently.

items: High value, low feasibility: strategic bets, plan foundations

deep.x: Scoring value
Scoring feasibility
Weighted scoring
Revisit
Scores change as data improves, platforms mature and models get better; re-score quarterly.
Make scoring transparent so stakeholders understand why their idea is, or isn't, first.

cards.title: A lista de verificação da viabilidade
cards.text: Os dados estão disponíveis e são suficientemente bons? O resultado pode ser verificado? O responsável pelo processo está empenhado? Há restrições legais ou regulamentares? Consegue integrar-se com os sistemas existentes?

deep.x: Before committing budget, check feasibility in detail. Most failures trace back to an unchecked item here.
Red flags
Quick data check
Pull a sample of real data in the first week. Many projects discover only late that data is missing, scattered or unusable.
Legal early
Involve legal, privacy and security at the idea stage for anything touching personal data, customers or regulated decisions.
A one-week "data spike", just getting and inspecting real data, prevents many expensive surprises.

cards.title: Nível de risco
cards.text: Classifica cada caso de uso pelo risco: redação interna é de baixo risco; decisões sobre pessoas (contratação, crédito) ou segurança são de alto risco e exigem controlos mais rigorosos.

deep.x: Risk-tiering ensures controls are proportionate. Low-risk uses move fast; high-risk uses get deeper review.

items: Tier 3, high: decisions about people, safety, legal effects
Tier 2, medium: customer-facing content, financial data

deep.x: Controls by tier
Aligning with regulation
Map internal tiers to the EU AI Act categories, plus sector rules (financial services, food safety) and data protection requirements.
Fast lanes
Pre-approved patterns (e.g. RAG over public documents with approved tools) can go through a lightweight review, speeding up delivery.
Risk-tiering speeds things up: it lets you say yes quickly to most ideas.

cards.title: Generativa vs. preditiva
cards.text: Escolhe a ferramenta certa: IA generativa para linguagem e documentos; ML preditivo para números e previsões; regras para lógica simples e determinística. Muitas soluções combinam-nas.

deep.x: Different problems need different AI families, and many solutions combine them.

items.b: understand and produce language, images, code
forecast numbers, classify, score from data

deep.x: Example combination
Common mistakes

l.t: Using an LLM to forecast prices from tables

r.t: Using ML models on structured data

deep.x: Rules aren't old-fashioned
For tax calculations, approval limits and compliance thresholds, rules are transparent, auditable and exact. AI should complement them, not replace them.
Asking a language model to "predict next quarter's sales" from a pasted table is a classic misuse; a forecasting model on the data is far more reliable.

cards.title: Copilotos vs. automação
cards.text: Os copilotos ajudam uma pessoa (a redigir, a sugerir), mantendo os humanos no controlo. A automação conclui tarefas de ponta a ponta. Os copilotos são mais fáceis de adotar primeiro; a automação traz poupanças maiores quando ganha confiança.

deep.x: Copilots assist humans in their work; automation completes tasks with minimal human involvement. Most organisations progress from one to the other as trust grows.
The autonomy ladder

items: Automate with exceptions: humans handle edge cases
Assist: AI drafts, human does the work

deep.x: Example: invoice processing
Choosing the level
Earn autonomy with evidence: start assisted, measure, then automate the proven parts.

cards.title: Portefólio de casos de uso
cards.text: Equilibra um portefólio: algumas vitórias rápidas para criar dinâmica, algumas apostas transformadoras maiores e bases que viabilizam tudo (dados, plataforma, competências).

deep.x: Managing AI as a portfolio balances near-term value, long-term bets and the foundations both need.
Portfolio categories

items.b: proven patterns, fast value, build momentum

deep.x: Governance
A portfolio board reviews progress quarterly, reallocates funding from stalled projects to promising ones and keeps alignment with strategy.
Stage-gated funding
Release funding in stages tied to evidence: discovery, pilot, scale. This limits losses on ideas that don't work.
Organisations that fund foundations explicitly tend to scale use cases faster because each project doesn't rebuild data pipelines from scratch.

cards.title: Escreve um resumo de uma página
cards.text: Para cada caso de uso: problema, utilizadores, valor esperado, dados necessários, métrica de sucesso, riscos, responsável. Uma página obriga a ter clareza antes de gastar dinheiro.

deep.x: A one-page brief clarifies thinking, aligns stakeholders and provides a reference for later evaluation.
Example headline

x: Problem: 5-day contract processing
Target: 1 day, ≥98% field accuracy
Value: ~€400k/yr capacity + fewer missed clauses

deep.x: Why one page
Long documents hide fuzzy thinking. One page forces prioritisation of what really matters and is quick for decision-makers to review.
Living document
Update the brief after the pilot with actual results; it becomes the basis for the scale-up decision.
If you can't fill in the success metric, you're not ready to start.

cards.title: Abandona depressa
cards.text: Nem todas as ideias funcionam. Define um prazo curto e critérios de sucesso claros para as experiências, e para as que não os cumprem. O objetivo é aprender depressa.

deep.x: Experiments should be cheap, quick and decisive. Clear criteria let teams stop unpromising ideas without stigma.
Kill criteria examples

items: Accuracy below threshold after two iterations

deep.x: Culture
Celebrate learning from stopped projects. Teams that fear failure hide problems and keep weak projects alive.
Capture lessons
Document what was learned: data issues, technical limits, user feedback. Future projects benefit.
Stopping a project early is a success of the process, not a failure of the team.

quiz.q: Que ideias devem normalmente avançar primeiro?
options: As de pouco valor e difíceis
As de alto valor e alta viabilidade
quiz.explain: Vitórias rápidas criam dinâmica.

quiz.q: Uma IA a decidir sobre candidatos a emprego está em que nível de risco?
quiz.explain: Decisões sobre pessoas são de alto risco.

quiz.q: A previsão da procura é mais adequada para…
quiz.explain: Números e histórico adequam-se a modelos preditivos.

lessons.title: Construir, comprar ou fazer parceria
lessons.summary: Escolher como obter capacidades de IA.

cards.title: Três opções
cards.text: Comprar: usar funcionalidades de IA do software que já tens ou ferramentas SaaS. Construir: desenvolver soluções próprias sobre modelos e plataformas. Parceria: trabalhar com um especialista ou integrador.

deep.x: Every AI capability can be bought, built or co-developed with a partner. Most organisations use all three across their portfolio.
Comparing

items.b: speed plus expertise, risk of dependence

deep.x: Decision factors
Ask: "Does doing this better than competitors matter?" If not, buy.

cards.title: Quando comprar
cards.text: Compra para necessidades comuns em que não te diferencias: redação de emails, notas de reuniões, chat genérico, funcionalidades padrão de RH ou CRM. É mais rápido e mais barato começar.

deep.x: Buying makes sense for horizontal capabilities that many organisations need in similar ways.
Advantages
Watch-outs

x: Data handling terms and residency
Licence costs at scale, often per user per month
Limited customisation for your processes
Vendor roadmap may not match your needs

deep.x: Check usage data after rollout: licences for AI add-ons are often bought broadly but used heavily by only a portion of staff.

cards.title: Quando construir
cards.text: Constrói onde a IA toca na tua vantagem competitiva ou em dados próprios, onde a integração com os sistemas centrais é profunda, ou onde as ferramentas prontas não se adaptam ao teu processo.

deep.x: Build when AI is close to your competitive advantage, uses proprietary data, or must integrate deeply into core processes.

items: Deep integration with ERP or trading systems
High volumes where unit costs matter

deep.x: Building on platforms
Building today rarely means training models. It means combining foundation models, retrieval, tools, guardrails and integrations on a platform.
Skills needed
Example
A trading company might build a contract intelligence solution that extracts terms into its CTRM and ERP, because no off-the-shelf product understands its contract templates and integration needs.
Build where the integration and data are the value; buy where the model alone is the value.

cards.title: IA integrada nos sistemas centrais
cards.text: ERP, CRM e suites de produtividade incluem cada vez mais IA (Microsoft Copilot, SAP Joule, Salesforce Einstein). Verifica o que já tens licenciado antes de construir.

deep.x: Major enterprise vendors are embedding AI assistants and agents into their platforms. These can be the fastest path to value for processes running inside those systems.
Advantages
Limits
Licensing
Embedded AI often comes with separate licences or consumption-based pricing. Review entitlements: some capabilities may already be included in existing contracts.

steps: Decide on add-ons or custom build

deep.x: SAP's Business Technology Platform lets companies extend SAP with custom AI while staying close to SAP data and security, a middle path between embedded and fully custom.

cards.title: Plataformas, não soluções avulsas
cards.text: Construir cada caso de uso do zero é lento. Uma plataforma de IA partilhada (acesso a modelos, RAG, guardrails, monitorização) permite às equipas construir muitas soluções mais depressa e de forma consistente.

deep.x: Without a shared platform, each team solves the same problems: model access, security reviews, retrieval, logging, evaluation. A platform makes the second and tenth use case much cheaper than the first.

items: Shared services: RAG, agents, prompt library
Model gateway: access to multiple models

deep.x: Benefits
Platform team
A small central team builds and runs the platform, while business-aligned teams build use cases on top: a "hub and spoke" model.
Avoid over-engineering
Build platform capabilities driven by real use-case demand, not speculative features.
A good AI platform makes the safe way the easy way.

cards.title: Dependência de fornecedor
cards.text: Depender de um único modelo ou fornecedor pode ser arriscado, porque o mercado muda depressa. Camadas de abstração, normas abertas e dados portáveis reduzem essa dependência.

deep.x: The AI market changes quickly: new models, price drops, providers' shifting strategies. Lock-in to one model or vendor can leave you paying more for less.
Mitigations

items.b: gateway or SDK supporting several models

deep.x: Balance
Some lock-in is acceptable for speed and integration benefits. The goal is optionality, not purity.
Test switching
Periodically run your evaluation set on alternative models to know your options and negotiating position.
Several organisations cut AI costs significantly by switching parts of their workload to newer, cheaper models, made easy by a gateway layer.

cards.title: Avaliar fornecedores

items: Termos de uso e retenção de dados

cards.text: Pede provas com os teus dados: precisão, certificações de segurança, termos de tratamento de dados, opções de integração, preços em escala e roadmap.

deep.x: Vendor claims are often based on demos with ideal data. Insist on evidence with your data and requirements.
Proof of concept
Run a structured proof of concept with predefined success criteria and your own evaluation set, comparing two or three vendors.
AI-specific questions

items.b: is our data used to train?

deep.x: Contract protections
Ask vendors what happens when the underlying model they use is deprecated; it reveals how mature their engineering is.

cards.title: Custo total
cards.text: Conta mais do que as licenças: integração, preparação de dados, gestão da mudança, monitorização, suporte e custos de utilização dos modelos ao longo de vários anos.

deep.x: AI total cost of ownership extends well beyond licences or token fees. Many projects underestimate integration and change costs.

items: Running costs: model usage, hosting, support

deep.x: Example 3-year view
Often missed

items: Business users' time in design and testing

deep.x: Cost drivers
Integration and change usually cost more than the AI model itself.

cards.title: Parceiros
cards.text: Integradores de sistemas e empresas especializadas trazem experiência e capacidade. Mantém o conhecimento essencial dentro de casa para não dependeres deles para cada mudança.

deep.x: System integrators, consultancies and specialist AI firms provide capacity, experience and speed, especially for organisations building their first solutions.
Good partnership models

items: Clear ownership of code and IP

deep.x: Keep core in-house

items.b: internal or managed with clear handover

deep.x: Choosing partners
Look for domain experience, references, engineering quality (not just slides), and willingness to work alongside your teams.
Building internal AI engineering capability, even small, greatly improves your ability to direct partners and evaluate their work.

cards.title: Revê regularmente
cards.text: O que constróis hoje pode tornar-se um produto banal no próximo ano. Revê as decisões de construir/comprar à medida que o mercado amadurece.

deep.x: The AI market moves fast. Custom solutions built today may become commodity products tomorrow; bought tools may stagnate while better options emerge.
Triggers for review

items: Major new model or platform releases

deep.x: Avoid sunk-cost thinking
If a vendor now offers what you built, consider switching and redeploying your team to differentiating work.
Review cadence
Twice-yearly portfolio reviews and annual architecture reviews keep decisions current.
Build for change: modular architectures make it cheap to swap parts as the market evolves.

quiz.q: Quando é que construir faz normalmente sentido?
options: Para processos centrais e diferenciadores com dados próprios
quiz.explain: Constrói onde te diferencias.

quiz.q: O que reduz a dependência de um fornecedor?
options: Camadas de abstração, normas abertas e seres dono dos teus dados
quiz.explain: Mantém as opções em aberto.

quiz.q: Antes de construir uma nova ferramenta de IA deves verificar…
options: Que funcionalidades de IA o teu software atual já oferece
quiz.explain: A IA integrada pode já resolver.

lessons.title: O business case
lessons.summary: Estimar valor, custo e ROI.

cards.title: Parte de uma linha de base
cards.text: Mede primeiro o processo atual: tempo por tarefa, volume, taxa de erros, custo, tempo de ciclo. Sem linha de base não consegues provar a melhoria.

deep.x: A baseline documents current performance before AI. It's the reference for proving value and often reveals surprising facts about the process.
Measuring methods
Example baseline
Pitfalls

x: Baselines estimated after the fact are often inflated
Seasonal variation distorts short measurements
Measure the whole process, not just the step AI touches

deep.x: Spend a week measuring before you spend months building.

cards.title: Valor do tempo poupado

viz.f: valor = volume × tempo poupado × custo/hora × adoção

cards.text: Uma estimativa simples: volume × tempo poupado por item × custo por hora × taxa de adoção. Sê conservador.

deep.x: Time savings are the most common AI benefit estimate. Keep estimates conservative and explicit.

v.f: value = volume × minutes saved × cost per minute × adoption

items.m: realistic share of users and cases

deep.x: Worked example

x: 400 contracts × 120 min saved = 48,000 min = 800 h a month
× €50/h × 70% adoption
≈ €28,000 a month

deep.x: Conservative adjustments
Capacity vs cash
Time saved is capacity, not automatically cash. It becomes financial value when used to avoid hiring, reduce overtime or outsourcing, or handle more business.

items: costs actually avoided or revenue gained

deep.x: Finance teams often discount "soft" time savings heavily; showing how freed capacity will be used makes cases more credible.

cards.title: Para além do tempo poupado
cards.text: Inclui melhorias de qualidade (menos erros), ciclos mais curtos (dinheiro recebido mais cedo), redução de risco e melhores decisões. Muitas vezes valem mais do que as horas poupadas.

deep.x: Many AI benefits exceed time savings and should be quantified where possible.

items.b: faster cycle times, earlier cash collection

deep.x: Example: faster invoicing

x: Invoice issued 3 days sooner
on €50 million monthly sales
at 5% cost of capital ≈ €250,000 a year in financing benefit

deep.x: Risk reduction
Estimating avoided losses uses expected value: probability × impact, before and after AI.
Strategic benefits
Some benefits, such as better employee experience, faster onboarding or improved customer satisfaction, are harder to quantify but real; describe them qualitatively alongside numbers.
In finance-heavy businesses, cash-flow and risk benefits often dwarf labour savings.

cards.title: Custos completos
cards.text: Inclui custos de construção, licenças ou uso de modelos, integração, preparação de dados, gestão da mudança, formação e custos de operação ao longo de vários anos.

deep.x: An honest business case includes all costs over a realistic period, typically three years.
Categories

items: One-off: build, integration, data cleanup, training
Hidden: business users' time, human review, governance

deep.x: Usage cost estimation
Estimate token usage from realistic volumes and prompt sizes; add a buffer for growth and retries.
Sensitivity
Show how costs change with volume and model choice. Cheaper models or caching can change the case significantly.
Business users' time spent in design, testing and reviewing outputs is often the largest uncounted cost.

cards.title: ROI e payback
cards.text: O ROI compara o ganho líquido com o custo; o payback é o tempo até o valor acumulado cobrir o investimento.

deep.x: Return on investment (ROI) and payback period summarise the business case for decision-makers. Net present value (NPV) adds the time value of money.

v.f: ROI = (total benefits − total costs) ÷ total costs

items.m: months until cumulative benefits ≥ cumulative costs

deep.x: Example

x: Benefits 3 years: €1.5 million
Costs 3 years: €0.9 million
ROI = 0.6 ÷ 0.9 ≈ 67%; payback ≈ 18 months

deep.x: Cumulative view
Choosing metrics
Show the cumulative curve: it makes the investment period and the upside visible.

cards.title: A adoção gera o valor
cards.text: Uma ferramenta que ninguém usa não entrega nada. Modela o valor com curvas de adoção realistas, a subir ao longo dos meses, e não 100% desde o primeiro dia.

deep.x: Value depends on how many people actually use the solution, how often, and for which cases. Adoption typically ramps up over months.
Drivers of adoption
Adoption metrics
Model the ramp
Budget for adoption activities, not just building: training, champions and communication.

cards.title: O tempo libertado tem de ser usado
cards.text: As horas poupadas só se tornam valor se forem reaproveitadas: mais volume tratado, melhor serviço, novo trabalho, ou menos horas extra e subcontratação.

deep.x: Saved time evaporates unless it's deliberately redirected. Without a plan, it disappears into email and meetings.

steps: Redeploy to higher-value work, growth or cost reduction

deep.x: Options for freed capacity
Management actions
Communicate
Be transparent about how capacity will be used, so staff see AI as an opportunity rather than a threat.
Linking AI rollouts to specific capacity goals ("clear the claims backlog by Q3") makes benefits concrete and visible.

cards.title: Intervalos, não pontos
cards.text: Os resultados da IA são incertos. Apresenta cenários baixo, esperado e alto, e os pressupostos de cada um.

deep.x: AI outcomes depend on accuracy, adoption and volumes, all uncertain. Presenting scenarios builds credibility.
Scenario assumptions
Sensitivity analysis
Identify which assumptions move results most, then validate them first in the pilot.
Decision rule
If even the low scenario is acceptable, proceed; if only the high scenario works, reconsider or redesign.
Executives trust ranges with clear assumptions more than precise numbers that turn out wrong.

cards.title: Mede depois do lançamento
cards.text: Acompanha as mesmas métricas da linha de base depois do lançamento e compara. Reporta resultados reais, incluindo o que não funcionou.

deep.x: Post-launch measurement proves value, finds problems and informs scaling decisions.
What to report
Attribution
Other changes (new staff, process tweaks, seasonality) also affect results. Use control groups or before-and-after comparisons with care.
Honest reporting
Report shortfalls too. Credibility from honest reporting makes it easier to fund the next initiatives.
Some organisations require a "benefits realisation review" six and twelve months after launch for every AI investment.

cards.title: Valor estratégico
cards.text: Alguns investimentos, como plataformas de dados ou competências de IA, não se pagam com um único caso de uso, mas viabilizam muitos. Financia-os como bases, com uma visão de portefólio.

deep.x: Foundational investments, such as data platforms, AI platforms, skills and governance, enable many future use cases and rarely justify themselves through one project.
Portfolio logic

steps: Each new use case cheaper and faster

deep.x: Real options thinking
Foundations create options: the ability to move quickly when new opportunities or models appear. Option value is real even if hard to quantify.
Funding approaches

v.unit: cost of the Nth use case, € thousands (illustrative)

deep.x: Judge foundations by the speed and cost of the use cases they enable.

quiz.q: 10 000 itens, 0,2 h poupadas em cada, 50 €/h e 50% de adoção dão cerca de…
Porque medir primeiro uma linha de base?
options: Para provar a melhoria mais tarde
quiz.explain: Sem ela, não se conseguem demonstrar ganhos.

quiz.q: O tempo poupado torna-se valor real quando…
options: É reaproveitado em trabalho valioso ou reduz custos
As pessoas fazem pausas mais longas
quiz.explain: O valor tem de ser concretizado.

lessons.title: Bases de dados
lessons.summary: Sem bons dados não há IA.

cards.title: Os dados são o estrangulamento

items: Sistemas de origem: ERP, CRM, ficheiros

cards.text: Para a maioria das empresas, a parte mais difícil da IA não é o modelo, mas encontrar, aceder, limpar e ligar os dados certos.

deep.x: Surveys of AI leaders consistently identify data readiness as the top barrier to scaling AI, ahead of models or skills.

items: Source systems: ERP, CRM, files, sensors

deep.x: Typical data problems
Generative AI raised the stakes
GenAI makes unstructured data valuable but exposes its mess: outdated documents, duplicates and missing permissions immediately show up in chatbot answers.
Invest early
Every AI use case benefits from the same foundations: catalogued, accessible, governed and good-quality data.
AI strategy is largely data strategy.

cards.title: Conhece os teus dados
cards.text: Um catálogo de dados lista que dados existem, onde estão, quem é o dono, o que significam e quão sensíveis são. Sem ele, as equipas perdem semanas à procura.

deep.x: A data catalogue is a searchable inventory of data assets, with business definitions, owners, quality indicators, sensitivity and lineage.
What a good entry contains
Business glossary
Agreeing definitions ("tonnes shipped" vs "tonnes invoiced", "active counterparty") avoids conflicting numbers and makes AI outputs consistent.

steps: Use in reports, AI and queries

deep.x: Benefits
Teams find data in hours instead of weeks, reuse trusted datasets, and AI systems (like text-to-SQL) can use definitions to answer correctly.
AI can help build catalogues by suggesting descriptions and classifications for thousands of tables automatically.

cards.title: Dimensões da qualidade dos dados
cards.text: Qualidade significa exatidão, completude, consistência, atualidade e unicidade. Um painel com a pontuação de qualidade de cada conjunto de dados-chave torna os problemas visíveis.

deep.x: Data quality is multidimensional. Measuring each dimension helps target fixes.
Quality scorecards
Automated checks
Data pipelines can run rules continuously (e.g. no negative quantities, valid port codes, matching currencies) and alert owners on failures.
Fix at source
Cleaning data downstream repeatedly is costly; fixing entry processes and validations at source prevents recurring problems.
Measure quality continuously; what isn't measured quietly degrades.

cards.title: Dados mestre

items.r: um registo mestre com nomes alternativos

cards.text: Clientes, fornecedores, produtos e materiais devem ter uma única versão fiável em todos os sistemas. Dados mestre desorganizados estragam tanto a análise como a IA.

deep.x: Master data describes core business entities: customers, suppliers, materials, products, locations. In multinationals with many ERP instances, the same supplier may exist under dozens of codes and spellings.

items.w: "COFCO Intl", "Cofco International Ltd", "COFCO INT'L" as separate records
items.r: One golden record with linked source IDs

deep.x: Why it matters for AI
Master data management (MDM)
MDM establishes golden records, governance processes and synchronisation across systems, often with tools like SAP Master Data Governance.
AI helps MDM
ML and embeddings match near-duplicate records far better than exact rules, proposing merges for data stewards to confirm.
In S/4HANA migrations, master data cleansing is often one of the longest and most critical workstreams, and a natural moment to prepare data for AI.

cards.title: Dados não estruturados
cards.text: Contratos, emails, PDFs e manuais têm imenso valor para a IA generativa, mas estão muitas vezes espalhados por drives e caixas de correio, com duplicados e versões desatualizadas.

deep.x: Unstructured content, such as contracts, emails, PDFs, presentations, manuals and chats, is where generative AI creates new value, but it's often the least governed data in a company.

items: Scattered across drives, sites and mailboxes

deep.x: Preparing content for AI
Content ownership
Like datasets, important document collections need owners who keep them current and decide what AI may use.
Records management
Retention schedules and legal holds apply to documents; AI indexing must respect deletions and legal requirements.
Cleaning a SharePoint before indexing it for AI is unglamorous and essential.

cards.title: Plataformas de dados
cards.text: As plataformas modernas (data lakehouses como Databricks, Microsoft Fabric ou Snowflake) juntam dados de muitos sistemas num único local governado para análise e IA.

deep.x: Modern data platforms consolidate data from many systems for analytics and AI, combining the flexibility of data lakes with the management of warehouses: the "lakehouse".
Leading platforms

items.b: lakehouse, strong ML and AI features
integrated with Azure and Power BI
cloud data platform with AI services

deep.x: Medallion architecture
A common pattern organises data in layers of increasing quality.
SAP data
Extracting SAP data while preserving business context is notoriously hard; vendors increasingly offer zero-copy sharing between SAP and data platforms to avoid duplication.
"Zero-copy" integration lets platforms query data where it lives instead of copying it, reducing duplication and synchronisation issues.

cards.title: Responsabilidade pelos dados
cards.text: Cada conjunto de dados importante precisa de um dono de negócio responsável pela sua qualidade e regras de acesso, apoiado por data stewards.

deep.x: Data governance assigns accountability. Without owners, nobody fixes quality issues or decides access.

items: Data steward: day-to-day quality and definitions

deep.x: Responsibilities
Federated governance
In large organisations, a central team sets standards and tools while domains (trading, logistics, finance) own their data: a "data mesh" style approach.
Making it real
Name owners for the top 20 datasets used in AI and analytics first, rather than trying to govern everything at once.
Ownership is the single most important governance decision.

cards.title: Produtos de dados
cards.text: Trata os conjuntos de dados-chave como produtos: documentados, com qualidade verificada, donos claros e níveis de serviço, para que muitas equipas os possam reutilizar com confiança.

deep.x: A data product is a dataset managed like a product: designed for consumers, documented, quality-assured and supported, with a clear owner.
Example

items.b: updated by 07:00 daily, 99% quality checks passed

deep.x: Benefits
Many teams reuse the same trusted data instead of building their own extracts, reducing inconsistency and cost.
For AI
AI use cases built on data products launch faster and are easier to maintain because inputs are stable and documented.
Treating data as a product shifts the question from "who has access?" to "who are our consumers and what do they need?"

cards.title: Linhagem
cards.text: A linhagem mostra de onde vieram os dados e como foram transformados. É essencial para confiar nos resultados da IA e para auditorias.

deep.x: Data lineage traces data from source through transformations to reports and models. It answers "where did this number come from?"
Why it matters

items.b: know what breaks if a source changes

deep.x: Regulatory relevance
The EU AI Act requires data governance and documentation for high-risk systems; financial regulators expect traceability of data used in reporting and risk models.
Automated lineage
Modern platforms capture lineage automatically from pipelines and queries, displaying graphs from source to dashboard.
When an executive asks "why is this forecast different?", lineage provides the answer.

cards.title: Classificação e acesso
cards.text: Classifica os dados (públicos, internos, confidenciais, restritos) e aplica regras de acesso, para que as ferramentas de IA só vejam o que cada utilizador pode ver.

deep.x: Data classification labels data by sensitivity; access controls enforce who can see what. AI tools must respect both.
AI-specific risks

items: Prompts containing confidential data sent to external models
Outputs combining data from different access levels

deep.x: Controls

items.b: e.g. Microsoft Purview labels on documents
restricted data only to private deployments

deep.x: Clean up permissions first
Many organisations discovered through AI pilots that documents were shared far more broadly than intended. Fixing oversharing is a prerequisite for enterprise AI search.

steps: Index for AI with access filters

deep.x: Microsoft and others offer "oversharing" reports specifically because AI assistants made over-broad permissions visible.

quiz.q: Qual é muitas vezes a parte mais difícil da IA empresarial?
options: Encontrar, aceder e limpar os dados certos
quiz.explain: Os dados são normalmente o estrangulamento.

quiz.q: O que são dados mestre?
options: A versão única e fiável de entidades centrais, como clientes e produtos
quiz.explain: Um único registo em todos os sistemas.

quiz.q: Porque classificar a sensibilidade dos dados?
options: Para que as regras de acesso possam ser aplicadas, incluindo às ferramentas de IA
quiz.explain: Os utilizadores e a IA só devem ver o que é permitido.

lessons.title: Arquitetura de IA empresarial
lessons.summary: Os blocos de construção de uma plataforma de IA.

cards.title: Camadas de uma plataforma de IA
cards.text: Uma plataforma de IA empresarial típica tem: fontes de dados, uma camada de dados, acesso a modelos, uma camada de orquestração (RAG, agentes), guardrails e aplicações, com segurança e monitorização transversais a tudo.

deep.x: An enterprise AI platform is less a single product than a set of layers. Each layer solves one problem once, so individual teams don't reinvent it for every use case.
Cross-cutting concerns
Some things don't belong to one layer; they run through all of them.

x: Identity and access: who can use which model, data and tool
Security: secrets, network isolation, encryption
Observability: logs, traces, cost and quality metrics
Governance: inventory, risk classification, approvals

deep.x: Build vs buy per layer

items.b: buy (cloud APIs) or host open models
mix of SaaS copilots and custom builds

deep.x: Why layers matter
Without a shared platform, every team picks its own model, vector database and logging. Five pilots later, the company has five security reviews, five bills and no reuse.
Build the platform once, then let use cases plug in. The second and tenth use case should be much cheaper than the first.

cards.title: O gateway de IA

steps: Gateway de IA: autenticação, encaminhamento, registos, quotas

cards.text: Um gateway central fica entre as aplicações e os modelos. Trata da autenticação, encaminhamento, quotas, registos, controlo de custos e filtros de conteúdo, e permite trocar de modelo de forma centralizada.

deep.x: An AI gateway is a proxy between applications and model providers. Every request passes through it, which makes it the natural place for control, measurement and flexibility.
What it does

x: Authentication: only approved apps and users get access
Routing: send each request to the right model or region, with fallbacks if a provider fails
Quotas and budgets: stop one runaway script burning the monthly budget
Logging and cost attribution per team and application
Content filters: block sensitive data going out, harmful content coming back

deep.x: Swapping models centrally
Because applications call the gateway rather than a vendor directly, you can switch models (cheaper, newer, different provider) by changing configuration, not dozens of applications.
Caching
Gateways can cache identical or near-identical requests, cutting cost and latency for repeated questions.
Many gateways expose an OpenAI-compatible API, so tools written for one provider can be redirected to others with minimal changes.

cards.title: Catálogo de modelos
cards.text: Disponibiliza modelos aprovados através do gateway: alguns modelos gerais de tamanhos diferentes, modelos de embeddings e modelos especializados. Documenta qual usar para quê.

deep.x: A model catalogue is the approved menu of models, with guidance on when to use each. It prevents both chaos (everyone picks their own) and waste (everyone uses the biggest model for everything).
Choosing a model
Documenting each entry
Each catalogue entry should record:

x: Provider, version and hosting region
Approved data classifications (public, internal, confidential)
Cost per million tokens and typical latency
Known strengths, weaknesses and evaluation results
Retirement date, since providers deprecate model versions

deep.x: Cost differences
Prices between the smallest and largest models in a provider's lineup often differ by more than ten times per token, so routing simple work to small models is a major cost lever.
Default to the smallest model that passes your evaluation, not the most famous one.

cards.title: Camada de conhecimento
cards.text: Serviços de RAG partilhados indexam coleções de documentos aprovadas com permissões, para que cada equipa não tenha de reconstruir do zero a pesquisa e a divisão em fragmentos.

deep.x: The knowledge layer is shared retrieval infrastructure: it ingests approved document collections, chunks and embeds them, and serves permission-aware search to any AI application.
Why share it
Chunking, OCR, table handling and permission sync are hard to get right. Doing them once, well, beats ten teams doing them badly.
Permission awareness
The index must store who can see each document and filter results at query time. Otherwise the assistant becomes a way to read documents you were never allowed to open.
Freshness

x: Incremental sync so new and changed documents appear quickly
Deletion propagation, so removed files disappear from answers
Metadata (date, owner, document type) to filter and rank results

deep.w: RAG is just plugging in a vector database
deep.r: most effort goes into document parsing, permissions, freshness and evaluation

cards.title: Ferramentas e integração
cards.text: Agentes e copilotos precisam de acesso seguro aos sistemas: ERP, CRM, ticketing. Expõe APIs ou servidores MCP bem definidos em vez de acesso amplo à base de dados.

deep.x: Agents become useful when they can act: look up an order, create a ticket, check a credit limit. That requires carefully designed access to core systems.
Narrow APIs, not database access
Give agents specific operations ("get invoice status by number") rather than broad database credentials. Narrow tools are easier to secure, audit and test.

items.r: Agent gets three narrow, logged API calls

deep.x: MCP servers

The Model Context Protocol (MCP), introduced by Anthropic in November 2024 and since adopted widely, is a standard way to expose tools and data to AI applications. One MCP server for your ERP can serve many assistants.
Design rules for tools

x: Clear names and descriptions, since the model chooses tools by reading them
Validate every input; never trust model-generated parameters blindly
Separate read tools from write tools, and require approval for writes
Return concise, structured results

deep.x: Treat every tool as a public API that a clever but unpredictable user will call.

cards.title: Guardrails

steps: Verificação de injeção e dados pessoais

cards.text: Filtros de entrada e saída procuram prompt injection, dados sensíveis, conteúdo tóxico e violações de políticas. Regras de negócio validam os resultados antes de chegarem a clientes ou sistemas.

deep.x: Guardrails are checks before and after the model. They catch what prompts alone can't guarantee: data leaks, harmful content, injected instructions and outputs that break business rules.
Input checks

x: Detect sensitive data (card numbers, IDs, health data) and mask or block it
Detect likely prompt injection or jailbreak attempts
Enforce topic scope ("this assistant only answers HR policy questions")

deep.x: Output checks

x: Toxicity and policy filters
Grounding checks: is each claim supported by retrieved sources?
Format validation: valid JSON, required fields present
Business rules: discount not above 15%, no promises on delivery dates

deep.x: Layered defence
No single layer is perfect; together they reduce risk to an acceptable level.
Deterministic checks (regular expressions, schema validation, numeric limits) are cheap and reliable; use them wherever possible before reaching for another AI model as a judge.

cards.title: Observabilidade

items: Custo por app e por equipa

cards.text: Regista prompts, respostas, chamadas a ferramentas, latência, custos e feedback dos utilizadores (com controlos de privacidade). Os traces ajudam a depurar falhas; os painéis mostram a utilização e a despesa.

deep.x: You can't improve or defend what you can't see. Observability means capturing enough about each AI interaction to debug failures, track quality and control cost.
Traces
A trace follows one request through every step: retrieval, model calls, tool calls, retries. When an agent does something odd, the trace shows exactly where it went wrong.
Dashboards

x: Usage: active users, requests per application
Spend: per team, per model, trend versus budget
Quality: thumbs up/down, correction and escalation rates
Reliability: error rates, latency percentiles, provider outages

deep.x: Privacy controls
Logs of prompts can contain personal and confidential data. Apply retention limits, access restrictions and masking, and include logs in your GDPR records.
Log enough to explain any answer after the fact, and protect those logs as carefully as the source data.

cards.title: Ambientes
cards.text: Separa desenvolvimento, testes e produção, com portas de avaliação antes de cada promoção, tal como noutro software.

deep.x: AI applications deserve the same release discipline as other software: separate environments, version control and gates before production.
What gets versioned

x: Prompts and system instructions
Model name and version
Retrieval configuration and index version
Tool definitions and guardrail rules

deep.x: Evaluation gates
Before promotion, run the change against a fixed evaluation set and compare with the current version. Quality, safety and cost must meet thresholds.
Test data
Test environments need realistic data. Use anonymised or synthetic samples, never casually copy production personal data into development.

deep.w: Prompt changes are too small to need testing
deep.r: a one-line prompt edit can change behaviour across thousands of cases

cards.title: Cloud e região

items: Dados da UE em regiões da UE
Sem treino com os teus dados
Cifra em repouso e em trânsito

cards.text: Escolhe regiões de alojamento dos modelos que cumpram as regras de residência de dados (por exemplo, dados da UE em regiões da UE) e termos contratuais que proíbam o treino com os teus dados.

deep.x: Where models run and what the contract says about your data matter as much as which model you choose, especially in the EU.
Data residency
Major cloud providers offer model hosting in EU regions and EU-only processing options, so prompts and outputs stay in the EU. Check where logging, abuse monitoring and support access happen too.
Contract terms to check

items.b: your data must not train provider models
how long prompts and outputs are stored

deep.x: Trade-offs

x: Newest models often reach a provider's own API before every cloud region
Self-hosting gives control but requires GPUs, skills and operations
Regional hosting can cost slightly more or offer fewer models

deep.x: Read the enterprise data terms, not the consumer ones: they are often very different.

cards.title: Arquitetura de referência
cards.text: Documenta uma arquitetura de referência e modelos reutilizáveis para que as equipas possam lançar novas aplicações de IA rapidamente, dentro dos guardrails.

deep.x: A reference architecture is a documented, approved blueprint plus reusable code templates. It turns each new AI project from a research effort into an assembly job.
Typical templates
What's pre-approved
When a team uses the reference architecture, security and privacy controls are already reviewed. Their review focuses only on what's new: the data and the use case.
Keeping it alive
The field moves fast. Assign an owner to update templates as models, frameworks and regulations change, and retire patterns that no longer fit.
A good test of a platform: how many days from idea to a secure, monitored pilot? Mature teams aim for days to a few weeks, not quarters.

quiz.q: O que oferece um gateway de IA?
options: Encaminhamento central, autenticação, registos, quotas e controlo de custos
quiz.explain: Um ponto de controlo entre as aplicações e os modelos.

quiz.q: Como devem os agentes aceder ao ERP ou ao CRM?
options: Com direitos totais de administrador da base de dados
Através de APIs ou servidores MCP bem definidos e com privilégio mínimo
quiz.explain: Limita o âmbito e regista as chamadas.

quiz.q: O que verificam os guardrails?
options: Entradas e saídas, à procura de injeção, dados sensíveis e violações de políticas
quiz.explain: Filtram antes e depois do modelo.

lessons.title: Segurança e privacidade na IA
lessons.summary: Novos riscos e como geri-los.

cards.title: Nova superfície de ataque
cards.text: Os sistemas de IA trazem novos riscos: prompt injection, fuga de dados através de prompts ou respostas, dados de treino ou de pesquisa envenenados, abuso de modelos e acesso inseguro a ferramentas.

deep.x: AI applications inherit all normal software risks and add new ones, because their behaviour is steered by natural language that attackers can also write.

items: Poisoning: bad training or RAG data

deep.x: The OWASP view
The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025 edition) ranks the main risks. The top entries include:

x: LLM01 Prompt injection
LLM02 Sensitive information disclosure
LLM03 Supply chain
LLM04 Data and model poisoning
LLM06 Excessive agency

deep.x: Why it's different
In an LLM application, any text the model reads can try to give it orders.

cards.title: Prompt injection

steps: Guardrails e permissões limitadas travam o dano

cards.text: Instruções maliciosas escondidas em emails, páginas web ou documentos podem levar um assistente de IA a revelar dados ou a executar ações. É considerado um dos principais riscos das aplicações com LLM (OWASP).

deep.x: Prompt injection hides instructions in content the AI processes: an email, a web page, a PDF, a calendar invite. The model can't reliably tell your instructions from the attacker's.
Direct vs indirect

items.b: user types malicious instructions into the chat
instructions hidden in documents, sites or emails the AI reads

deep.x: Indirect injection is the bigger enterprise risk, because the victim never sees the attack.
The lethal combination

Researcher Simon Willison, who coined the term "prompt injection" in 2022, warns about a "lethal trifecta": an agent that has access to private data, reads untrusted content and can communicate externally can be tricked into exfiltrating data.
Defences

x: Remove one leg of the trifecta wherever possible
Require human approval for sensitive actions
Restrict which domains the agent can send data to
Separate and label untrusted content; filter suspicious instructions
Give agents minimal permissions

deep.w: Better prompts can fully stop injection
deep.r: no known technique is fully reliable; design so a successful injection can't do much harm

cards.title: Fuga de dados

items: Deteção e ocultação de dados pessoais

cards.text: Os dados sensíveis podem fugir se os utilizadores os colarem em ferramentas não aprovadas, se o RAG ignorar permissões ou se as respostas incluírem detalhes confidenciais. Controlos: ferramentas aprovadas, pesquisa que respeita permissões e filtros de saída.

deep.x: Data leaks through AI in three main ways: people paste it into the wrong tools, systems retrieve what users shouldn't see, or outputs reveal confidential details.
A famous example
In 2023, Samsung restricted staff use of public chatbots after engineers pasted confidential source code and meeting notes into ChatGPT.
Controls

items.b: provide approved ones, block or warn on others
filters for secrets and personal data

deep.x: Data classification helps
If documents are labelled (public, internal, confidential, restricted), rules become simple: "restricted data only in approved, EU-hosted tools with no retention".

x: Data loss prevention (DLP) tools can detect sensitive content in prompts
Browser controls can warn when pasting into unknown AI sites

deep.x: Most AI leaks are ordinary data governance failures made faster and more visible.

cards.title: Shadow AI
cards.text: É comum os colaboradores usarem ferramentas de IA não aprovadas ("shadow AI") quando faltam opções aprovadas. A melhor defesa é disponibilizar boas ferramentas aprovadas e orientações claras.

deep.x: Shadow AI is the use of AI tools without company approval: personal ChatGPT accounts, browser plugins, free transcription apps. Surveys consistently find it widespread.
Why it happens

x: Approved tools are missing, slow or worse than consumer apps
Staff don't know the rules or the risks
The productivity benefit is real and immediate

deep.x: Risks
The better response

Provide a good enterprise assistant quickly, publish a one-page "what you can and can't do", and monitor network traffic to see which tools are in demand. Demand signals tell you what to approve next.
Many organisations found that usage of unapproved tools dropped sharply once a good approved assistant was rolled out.

cards.title: Privilégio mínimo para agentes

items: Limites de pedidos e de despesa

cards.text: Dá aos agentes de IA o acesso mínimo necessário, tokens com âmbito limitado, limites de utilização e passos de aprovação para ações sensíveis. Trata-os como um novo colaborador com direitos muito limitados.

deep.x: An AI agent should have the minimum permissions needed for its task and nothing more, just like a new employee on day one.
Practical controls

x: Scoped, short-lived tokens instead of shared admin accounts
Read-only by default; write access only where essential
Rate limits and spending caps per agent
Allow-lists of systems, domains and recipients
Human approval for payments, deletions, external emails

deep.x: Whose identity?

items.b: agent inherits the user's rights, never more
agent has its own narrow account
read as user, act via approved service

deep.x: Blast radius
Ask: if this agent is fully compromised by an injection, what's the worst it can do? Design so the answer is acceptable.
Assume the agent will eventually be tricked, and limit what a tricked agent can do.

cards.title: Cadeia de fornecimento
cards.text: Modelos, bibliotecas e plugins vêm de terceiros. Verifica as fontes, analisa as dependências e fixa versões, como em qualquer outra cadeia de fornecimento de software.

deep.x: AI systems are built from third-party parts: models, weights, libraries, plugins, datasets and MCP servers. Each is a potential way in for attackers.
Real risks

x: Malicious model files: some formats can run code when loaded, so prefer safe formats like safetensors
Typosquatted packages with names similar to popular AI libraries
Unvetted plugins or MCP servers with broad permissions
Poisoned public datasets

deep.x: Controls

items.b: list every component (an AI bill of materials)

deep.x: Vendor due diligence
For hosted models and AI SaaS, review security certifications, data terms, sub-processors and incident history, as for any critical supplier.
An AI bill of materials (AI-BOM) extends the software bill of materials idea to list models, datasets and their versions.

cards.title: Dados pessoais e RGPD

steps: Novo caso de uso de IA

cards.text: Usar dados pessoais em IA exige um fundamento jurídico, limitação da finalidade, minimização e muitas vezes uma avaliação de impacto sobre a proteção de dados (AIPD). Envolve o EPD desde cedo.

deep.x: GDPR applies fully to AI. Any processing of personal data, whether training, fine-tuning, retrieval or prompts, needs a legal basis and must respect data protection principles.
Key principles applied to AI

items.b: data collected for payroll isn't automatically usable for AI training
only the personal data truly needed
AI outputs about people must be correctable
delete prompts and logs when no longer needed

deep.x: DPIA

A data protection impact assessment is required when processing is likely to be high risk, which often applies to new AI uses involving employees, customers or profiling. The data protection officer (DPO) should be involved early, not at launch.
Automated decisions

Article 22 GDPR gives people the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing that have legal or similarly significant effects, such as rejecting a loan or job application, except under specific conditions with safeguards.

x: Meaningful human review, not rubber-stamping
Right to contest and obtain an explanation

deep.x: Involve the DPO at the design stage: privacy fixes are cheap early and expensive late.

cards.title: Red teaming
cards.text: Antes do lançamento, testa as apps de IA como um adversário: tenta injeções, jailbreaks, extração de dados e utilização abusiva. Corrige os problemas e volta a testar.

deep.x: Red teaming means attacking your own AI system before real attackers or unlucky users do. It finds failures that normal testing misses.
What to try
Who does it

x: Security specialists who know injection techniques
Domain experts who know what a harmful answer looks like
Ordinary users who misuse things in unexpected ways
Automated tools that generate thousands of attack variants

deep.x: Make it repeatable
Turn every successful attack into a test case in your evaluation set, so a future prompt or model change can't quietly reopen the hole.
Frontier AI labs run large red-teaming exercises with external experts before releasing major models, and publish summaries in system cards.

cards.title: Resposta a incidentes
cards.text: Tem um plano para incidentes de IA: respostas prejudiciais, exposição de dados, erros de agentes. Tens de conseguir desativar funcionalidades depressa, investigar os registos e notificar quando for obrigatório.

deep.x: AI incidents will happen: a chatbot gives wrong policy advice, an agent emails the wrong customer, a document leaks via search. Preparation decides whether they are minor or major.
AI-specific incident types
Kill switches
Every AI feature should have a way to disable it instantly via feature flag, without a code deployment. Agents should be stoppable mid-task.
Legal clocks

items.b: notify the authority within 72 hours when required
serious incidents with high-risk systems must be reported
significant incidents reported quickly for covered entities

deep.x: A lesson in liability
In 2024 a Canadian tribunal ordered Air Canada to honour a refund policy its website chatbot had invented. The airline argued the chatbot was responsible for its own words; the tribunal disagreed.
Your company owns what its AI says and does. Plan incidents accordingly.

cards.title: Referenciais de segurança
cards.text: Usa orientações consolidadas: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001 para sistemas de gestão de IA, e ainda os teus controlos ISO 27001 existentes.

deep.x: You don't need to invent AI security from scratch. Established frameworks provide checklists and structure, and they map onto existing security programmes.

items.b: risk framework: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage

deep.x: NIST AI RMF
Published in January 2023 by the US National Institute of Standards and Technology, the AI Risk Management Framework organises work into four functions. A generative AI profile followed in 2024.
ISO/IEC 42001
The first international standard for AI management systems, published in December 2023. Like ISO 27001 for security, organisations can be certified against it.
MITRE ATLAS
A knowledge base of real-world attack techniques against AI systems, modelled on the well-known MITRE ATT&CK framework.

x: Use OWASP for developers' checklists
Use NIST or ISO 42001 for the management system
Map AI controls into existing ISO 27001 processes

deep.x: Extend your existing security programme to AI rather than building a separate one.

quiz.q: O que é a shadow AI?
options: Colaboradores a usar ferramentas de IA não aprovadas
quiz.explain: Combate-se melhor com boas ferramentas aprovadas.

quiz.q: Que princípio limita os danos de um agente sequestrado?
options: Privilégio mínimo com aprovações para ações sensíveis
quiz.explain: Direitos mínimos limitam os danos.

quiz.q: Que norma define um sistema de gestão de IA?
quiz.explain: Publicada em 2023.

lessons.title: Governação e risco da IA
lessons.summary: Políticas, papéis e o Regulamento Europeu da IA na prática.

cards.title: Porquê governação

items: incidentes, ou aprovações lentas e shadow AI

cards.text: A governação garante que a IA é usada de forma segura, legal e alinhada com os valores da empresa, sem abrandar tudo. Uma boa governação acelera a adoção ao clarificar as regras.

deep.x: AI governance is the set of rules, roles and processes that keep AI use safe, legal and aligned with company values. Done well, it speeds adoption by removing uncertainty.
What it covers
The enabling role
Teams often stall because nobody knows whether something is allowed. A clear policy with pre-approved patterns lets most work start immediately.
Signs of bad governance

x: Every request goes to the same overloaded committee
Reviews take months, regardless of risk
Rules exist on paper but nobody follows them
Nobody knows which AI systems are actually running

deep.x: Governance should be a paved road, not a toll booth.

cards.title: Política de IA

items: Como propor novos casos de uso

cards.text: Uma política curta cobre as ferramentas aprovadas, os dados permitidos, a supervisão humana, a transparência, os usos proibidos e como pedir novos casos de uso.

deep.x: An AI policy is the short, readable rulebook for employees. Long legal documents go unread; the best policies fit on a page or two with examples.
Example rules
Make it usable

x: Use traffic-light examples: green, amber, red
Link to the request form for new tools
Name a contact for questions
Review it every six to twelve months, as tools change fast

deep.x: Prohibited uses
Typical lists include uploading restricted data to unapproved tools, using AI to monitor employees' emotions, and generating content that impersonates real people.
Policies that explain why a rule exists are followed far better than bare prohibitions.

cards.title: Inventário de sistemas de IA
cards.text: Mantém um registo dos sistemas e casos de uso de IA: finalidade, responsável, dados usados, modelo, nível de risco e controlos. Na prática, o Regulamento Europeu da IA obriga a saber o que implantas.

deep.x: An AI inventory is a register of every AI system and use case in the company. You can't govern, secure or comply for systems you don't know about.
Why it's essential
The EU AI Act assigns obligations based on each system's risk category and on whether you are the provider or deployer. Without an inventory, you can't even start classifying.
Finding hidden AI

x: AI features switched on inside existing SaaS tools
Vendor products marketed as "smart" or "intelligent"
Spreadsheets and scripts calling AI APIs
Pilots that quietly became production

deep.x: Keep it alive

items: linked to procurement and release processes

deep.x: If procurement and IT change processes feed the register automatically, it stays current.

cards.title: Revisão baseada no risco
cards.text: Os usos de baixo risco têm uma autoavaliação leve; os de alto risco passam por uma revisão completa com especialistas jurídicos, de segurança, de privacidade e do negócio.

deep.x: Not every AI use needs the same scrutiny. A risk-based process sends low-risk uses through a quick check and reserves deep review for systems that can really hurt people or the business.
Triage questions

x: Does it make or influence decisions about people?
Does it use personal or confidential data?
Is the output customer-facing or acted on automatically?
Could errors cause financial, legal or safety harm?
Is it a high-risk category under the EU AI Act?

deep.x: Tiers

items.b: internal drafting with approved tools, self-assessment
customer-facing with human review, light review
decisions about people or critical operations, full review and monitoring

deep.x: Speed targets
Set service levels: low-risk in days, medium in two weeks, high in a defined, published timeline. Predictability matters as much as speed.

deep.w: Every AI use needs a committee approval
deep.r: this creates bottlenecks and drives shadow AI; most uses are low risk

cards.title: O Regulamento Europeu da IA para empresas

items: Conhecer os usos de alto risco

cards.text: As empresas são normalmente "responsáveis pela implantação" de IA. Nos sistemas de alto risco, têm de os usar conforme as instruções, garantir supervisão humana, monitorizar o funcionamento, guardar registos e informar as pessoas afetadas. As práticas proibidas têm de ser totalmente evitadas.

deep.x: The EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) entered into force in August 2024 and applies in stages. Most companies are "deployers": they use AI systems built by others, which carries lighter but real duties.
Risk categories
Deployer duties for high-risk systems

x: Use the system according to the provider's instructions
Assign human oversight to trained, competent people
Ensure input data under your control is relevant
Monitor operation and report serious incidents
Keep automatically generated logs (at least six months)
Inform workers before using high-risk AI at the workplace

deep.x: Examples of high-risk uses
Fines
Up to €35 million or 7% of global annual turnover for prohibited practices, and up to €15 million or 3% for most other breaches.
The EU proposed in late 2025 to delay some high-risk deadlines; check the current timeline before planning compliance work.

cards.title: Dever de literacia em IA

items.l: aplica-se o dever de literacia em IA
que usa sistemas de IA abrangidos

cards.text: Desde fevereiro de 2025, o Regulamento Europeu da IA exige que fornecedores e responsáveis pela implantação tomem medidas para garantir literacia em IA suficiente entre o pessoal que opera ou usa sistemas de IA.

deep.x: Article 4 of the EU AI Act requires providers and deployers to take measures to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy among staff dealing with AI systems. It has applied since 2 February 2025.

items.l: risk levels covered, not just high risk

deep.x: What "sufficient" means
The Act doesn't prescribe a course. Literacy should fit people's roles, technical knowledge and the context in which AI is used.

items.b: what AI is, limits, policy, data rules

deep.x: Practical programme

x: Short mandatory basics for everyone using AI tools
Role-based modules for developers, HR, legal, managers
Documented attendance and materials as evidence
Refreshers as tools and rules change

deep.x: Beyond compliance
Literacy is also the biggest driver of value: people who understand AI's strengths and limits use it more and more safely.
Treat AI literacy as a productivity programme that also satisfies a legal duty.

cards.title: Papéis e responsabilidades
cards.text: Papéis típicos: um patrocinador executivo, um comité de governação de IA, responsáveis pelos casos de uso, uma equipa central de IA, e ainda as funções jurídica, de privacidade, de segurança e de risco.

deep.x: Clear roles prevent both gaps (nobody owns the risk) and gridlock (everybody must approve everything).

items: Central AI team: platform and standards
Control functions: legal, privacy, security, risk

deep.x: Who does what
The three lines model
Many companies map AI onto the familiar three lines: business owners manage risk (first line), risk and compliance set rules and oversee (second), internal audit gives independent assurance (third).

items: First line: business and IT owners

deep.x: Avoid

x: Governance owned only by IT or only by legal
A board with no business representation
Use cases with no named owner after launch

deep.x: Some companies appoint a Chief AI Officer; others give the role to the CDO or CIO. The title matters less than clear accountability.

cards.title: Gestão do risco de modelos
cards.text: Os bancos e outras empresas reguladas já gerem o risco de modelos: validação, documentação, monitorização do desempenho. Alarga estas práticas à IA e aos LLM.

deep.x: Banks have managed "model risk" for over a decade: the risk that decisions based on models are wrong. Those practices transfer well to AI and LLMs.
Origins
The US Federal Reserve's SR 11-7 guidance (2011) defined model risk management for banks. In the UK, the PRA's SS1/23 principles took effect in 2024 and explicitly include AI models.
Core practices

x: An inventory of models with risk ratings
Documentation of purpose, data, assumptions and limits
Independent validation before use
Ongoing performance monitoring and periodic revalidation

deep.x: Adapting to LLMs

x: Vendor models can change under you: pin versions and re-test on updates
Validation uses evaluation sets and red teaming rather than only statistical tests

deep.x: If your company already has model risk management, extend it; don't build a parallel AI process.

cards.title: IA de terceiros

items: Uso de dados e restrições ao treino

cards.text: Muitos riscos de IA chegam através de fornecedores. Os contratos devem cobrir o uso dos dados, a segurança, a transparência, a notificação de incidentes e o cumprimento de leis como o Regulamento da IA.

deep.x: Most corporate AI arrives through vendors: cloud models, SaaS copilots, AI features added to existing software. Many of the risks therefore sit in contracts.
Due diligence questions

items.b: is our data used to train models?
where is data processed and stored?
which model providers are behind the product?
will we be told when models change?
who covers IP and output claims?

deep.x: Features switched on silently
SaaS vendors frequently add AI features in updates. Procurement and IT should review release notes and default settings, and the AI inventory should capture them.
AI Act roles
If you substantially modify a high-risk system or put your own name on it, you can become its "provider" under the AI Act, with much heavier obligations.
Several major AI providers offer contractual indemnities against copyright claims arising from their enterprise products' outputs, subject to conditions.

cards.title: Equilibrar rapidez e controlo
cards.text: Padrões pré-aprovados (ferramentas aprovadas, modelos, categorias de baixo risco) permitem que a maioria das equipas avance depressa, enquanto o escrutínio se concentra nos casos de alto risco.

deep.x: The goal is to let most AI use proceed quickly while focusing scrutiny where it matters. Good governance is measured by both safety and speed.
Pre-approved patterns

x: Approved tools with approved data classes: no review needed
Reference architectures with reviewed controls: delta review only
Low-risk categories (internal drafting, summarising): self-certify

deep.x: Measuring governance

items.b: median days from request to approval
share of AI systems in the inventory

deep.x: Continuous adjustment
Review which categories cause incidents and which never do. Loosen rules where risk proved low and tighten where problems appear.
If governance is too slow, people route around it, and you lose both speed and control.

quiz.q: O que deve registar um inventário de IA?
options: Caso de uso, responsável, dados, modelo, nível de risco e controlos
quiz.explain: É a base da governação.

quiz.q: Desde fevereiro de 2025, o Regulamento Europeu da IA exige que os responsáveis pela implantação garantam…
options: Literacia em IA suficiente entre o pessoal que usa IA
quiz.explain: A obrigação de literacia em IA.

quiz.q: Como deve a governação tratar os casos de uso de baixo risco?
options: Dar-lhes uma via rápida com verificações leves
quiz.explain: Governação proporcional.

lessons.title: IA responsável
lessons.summary: Princípios que criam confiança.

cards.title: Princípios comuns
cards.text: A maioria dos referenciais de IA responsável partilha princípios: equidade, transparência, responsabilização, privacidade, segurança e fiabilidade, e supervisão humana.

deep.x: Dozens of companies, governments and bodies have published responsible AI principles. The lists are remarkably similar, which makes them a useful common language.
Key sources
From principles to practice
Principles alone change nothing. They need to become concrete checks in design reviews, evaluation criteria and monitoring.
Example translation

x: Fairness → test error rates across groups before launch
Transparency → label AI-generated customer messages
Accountability → named owner in the AI inventory

deep.w: Responsible AI is a separate ethics project
deep.r: it works best embedded in normal product, risk and quality processes

cards.title: Equidade
cards.text: Verifica se a IA não trata as pessoas de forma injusta com base em características protegidas ou em indicadores indiretos. Testa os resultados por grupo em qualquer uso que afete pessoas.

deep.x: An AI system is unfair when it systematically disadvantages people based on protected characteristics such as sex, ethnicity, age or disability, or on proxies for them.
How bias enters
Real cases

x: Amazon scrapped an experimental CV-screening tool, reported in 2018, after it learned to penalise CVs mentioning "women's"
